plain.li: [buy,feed] That'll keep the herd going a few more days.
[buy,feed,drovers] The beasts will thank you for this.
[buy,meal] A meal someone else cooked, at last.
[buy,roadfood] This will keep on the road.
[buy,rawfood] Something fresh for the pot tonight.
[buy,medicine] Better to carry it and not need it.
[buy,textiles] Good cloth, it'll mend a lot of tears.
[buy,metal] Good metal, I can work with this.
[buy,art] Someone back home will pay well for this.
[dear] Too dear for me, I'll leave it.
[dear] I'd hoped it would be cheaper.
[none] Not what we need, more's the pity.
